description: This file defines classes, macros, and functions related to warning reporting control within a software system. It includes mechanisms for categorizing warnings, serializing/deserializing warning data, and managing warning categories and exclusions. The file also provides macros for reporting warnings and out-of-bounds conditions, and manages warning categories with configurable bounds and behaviors.

classes.name: WarningReportingBoundsCategory
classes.description: Manages warning bounds and analysis for a specific warning category, including serialization, deserialization, and analysis based on configured bounds.

classes.name: WarningReportingType
classes.description: Template class that manages warning reporting for a specific category, including enabling/disabling, serialization, and analysis.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy
classes.description: Singleton proxy class that manages warning reporting categories, including reporting events, fetching category info, and managing category list.

classes.name: ExcludedWarnings
classes.description: Manages lists of callsigns and modules excluded from warning reports.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures warning bounds for a category based on provided settings string.

methods.name: CategoryName
methods.description: Returns the name of the warning category.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes a warning condition based on actual value and category bounds, returning whether to report.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes warning category data into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes warning category data from a buffer.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts warning category data to a string representation.

methods.name: IsWarning
methods.description: Determines if the current warning is a warning or an error based on bounds.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks if warning reporting is enabled.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up and revokes control of warning category.
